profile_text.body:
Wix.com Ltd. is a public company headquartered in Tel Aviv that trades under the ticker WIX and is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001576789. Its own site presents it as a website builder: the company describes a free, easy-to-use builder that offers 2,000+ templates, a custom domain, and built-in AI tools. Templates can be customized manually or with AI, according to the site.

The site also describes commerce features, saying users can sell products, services, and memberships from one dashboard with zero plugins, and that businesses can keep growing with specialized AI agents. Beyond those built-in AI tools and agents, the material does not name specific AI products.

No litigation is recorded for the company, and no MCP servers or separately tracked products are listed.
